links.outcome: Comprehensibility and readability of LLM and website medical information for andrology patients (DISCERN, Flesch)
links.effect: Most common websites and LLMs gave sufficient information but lacked easy comprehensibility and readability.
links.quote: In general, most common websites and LLMs provide sufficient information but lack easy comprehensibility and readability.

screen.reason: The study surveyed patients on information-seeking behavior and evaluated the readability and quality of LLM-generated health information compared to traditional websites, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
